name: BC7 (Hubble)
blurb: BC7, a tiny isolated stellar system in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: bc7-hubble
story: BC7 belongs to a recently found class of tiny, isolated systems of young stars adrift in the hot gas of the Virgo Cluster. They likely formed from gas stripped out of a galaxy, and Hubble looked here to confirm this one and study its stars.

claims.text: BC7 (BC1224+1148) is a confirmed blue blob in the Virgo cluster
Blue blobs are a recently discovered class of isolated, tiny stellar systems in the Virgo cluster
Blue blobs are faint, isolated star-forming clouds embedded in the hot intracluster medium of the Virgo cluster, made of only young stars
Blue blobs likely formed from gas stripped from galaxies
Hubble program 17267 images three candidates, BC7 among them, to confirm them and study their properties
